(2) Notwithstanding the provisions of sub-section (1) of
this section, any instrument executed in the Federation by
a body corporate incorporated by any Federal or State law
need not be attested in accordance with the provisions of
such sub-section if it is duly executed in the manner
prescribed by such Federal or State law.
